text:
Ava (partnerships): Hey team — scheduling the HeliumBoard joint perf run next Tue/Wed. Goal: validated perf/W and steady-state throughput for our 8k and 32k samples. Can we confirm scope and who'll own kernel tweaks? :calendar:
Markus (HeliumBoard): I can bring our kernel lead (cc'ed in calendar invite). We can open a dev build with PMU hooks and thermal telemetry. Expecting ~2 hours of handoffs then runs. :thumbsup:
Priya (eng-ml): Thanks. Need to confirm workloads: do you want the Llama-2 family + a distilled chat model? Also we'll provide sequence-length histograms. Prefer both token-generation and batched-inference patterns.
Markus (HeliumBoard): Llama-2-13b and a 7b distilled. We'll prepare a microkernel patch for AVX/AMX paths — can test with/without it. Thermal headroom varies by board, I'll include fan profiles.
Diego S. (eng-runtime): For the runbook we need: exact model binaries, quantization (int8/qat), batch sizes to sweep, concurrency targets, and timeout SLOs. Also point bench telemetry to our influx endpoint: bench:write token ready?
Ava (partnerships): Diego — I'll add the bench token to the secure invite. Markus — please upload kernel patch diff and a sample perf script to the shared folder before EOD Fri.
Markus (HeliumBoard): Uploading now — link: https://files.heliumboard.example/helium-kernel-diff_v3.patch
Priya (eng-ml): Quick note on metrics: measure both median token latency and p99 for latency-sensitive configs; calculate watt-per-token using wall-power and GPU-PMU samples. We'll provide a PromQL snippet for derived metrics.
Diego S. (eng-runtime): PromQL snippet (for reference):
```
avg_over_time((sum by(instance) (gpu_power_watts) / sum by(instance) (generated_tokens_total))[5m:1m])
```
Use that with the wall meter delta to get perf/W.
Ava (partnerships): Proposed test matrix (high level):
- Model: 7b, 13b
- Quant: fp16, int8
- Batch sizes: 1, 4, 16
- Seq len: 512, 2048, 8192
- Kernel: upstream, helium-patch-v3
We'll run each config for 10 minutes steady-state and capture thermal drift. Thoughts?
Priya (eng-ml): Add a synthetic tail-run (long streaming session) to exercise KV-cache eviction. Also capture sample prompt set (we'll push to the shared drive).
Markus (HeliumBoard): Fan profiles: low/nominal/high. We'll test nominal + high. Note: on low fans you might see thermal throttling after ~7 minutes at 32k sequences.
Ava (partnerships): OK — owners: Markus (kernel + hardware telemetry), Priya (workload and evaluation prompts), Diego (runbook + telemetry sinks), Ava (scheduling + partner comms). bench-bot, please kick off a smoke-run once uploads complete. :robot_face:
bench-bot: smoke-run queued. Running quick fp16 13b throughput check at batch=4 now. Will post results in thread.
bench-bot: smoke-run result: 13b fp16 batch=4 steady QPS=125, median token latency=18ms, p99=42ms. No thermal events in 5m trial. :white_check_mark:
Diego S. (eng-runtime): Good sanity check. Markus — when you upload the patched kernel can you also include kernel configs used? e.g., governor, cstates, irq affinity.
Markus (HeliumBoard): Yep — included in upload (helium-kernel-diff_v3.patch + run_configs/).
Ava (partnerships): Final ask: we'd like a short joint blog blurb draft after the run summarizing perf/W improvements and any tradeoffs. Markus/Priya can we aim for a draft by Fri afternoon?
Priya (eng-ml): I'll draft the technical summary (metrics + methodology). Markus — can you provide quote and any caveats?
Markus (HeliumBoard): Will do.
Ava (partnerships): Great — see calendar invite. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
